### Christian, Is Your Hope Defined by God or Your Desires?
Author: Oyewole Akande
Site: TGC Africa
URL: https://africa.thegospelcoalition.org/article/christian-is-your-hope-defined-by-god-or-your-desires/
Passage: Titus 1:2
Points:
- Worldly hope is merely wishful thinking, whereas biblical hope is confident anticipation of what is guaranteed to happen.
- Christian confidence rests entirely on the character of God, who by His nature never lies.
- Believers and pastors must be careful not to mistake their personal desires or unpromised earthly breakthroughs for God's promises.
- What God has explicitly promised to all believers is the enduring hope of eternal life in union with Christ.
- Anchoring our hope in God's truthful word removes the dread of death and gives solid peace for the future.
